uncited: **Time Complexity:** Dictionary training is iterative and expensive.
Encoding is dominated by OMP, which is linear in dictionary size per block.
**Memory Complexity:** Dictionary size $D$ (e.g., $1024$ atoms of dimension $256$) is stored in memory.
**Limitations:** High training time; encoding is slower than fixed-basis methods; sensitive to training data distribution.
**When not to use:** When encoding latency is critical or training data is unavailable.
The K-SVD algorithm was introduced by Elad and Aharon [MAB06] as a generalization of K-Means.
